data.name: Ghufair
data.gender_notes: Ghufair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ghafara' which means 'to cover'. The name Ghufair is often used to describe a young, handsome man. In the Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) gave the name to a companion, Al-Ash'ath ibn Qais Al-Kindi, due to his youthful appearance and strength.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of beauty and youth, symbolizing the journey of spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Ghufair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghufair total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
